WHY THIS IS A DAY-ONE DECISION, not a later one:
Godot writes every parameter individually into each .import sidecar rather
than recording 'uses default'. Changing these values later does NOT
propagate to anything already imported. Retrofitting means deleting every
.import file to force a project-wide reimport, which produces a very large
diff. Set the profile before the first asset lands.
Pick by target, not by taste. Add your own profiles freely; the gate does
not care which one you use, only that assets have committed sidecars.

desktop-3d.description: Forward+ desktop. Quality first, VRAM is cheap, mipmaps for 3D.
